module: Extension of SLAXML (third-party library by Gavin Kistner): adds to the SLAXML table a `dom` parser that builds a flat DOM (with nsPrefix, cdata) and an `xml` serializer that rewrites a node or a document as XML text (indentation, attribute sorting, omission of namespaces). The module returns the modified SLAXML table. Used by xlsxlib and by the JUnit writers of the testFramework.
usage: local SLAXML = require('libs/slaxml/slaxdom') local doc = SLAXML:dom('texte') print(doc.root.name, doc.root.attr.x) print(SLAXML:xml(doc, {indent = 2}))
notes: Loading this module replaces `SLAXML.dom` defined in slaxml.lua (the version here adds nsPrefix, cdata and the error on non-blank text at the root) and defines `SLAXML.xml`.
In `opts.simple` mode, `doc.root` is not set (nil) and the `parent` links / `el` lists are not created.
Each attribute exists twice: in `element.attr[i]` (list of attribute nodes) and, outside simple mode, in `element.attr[name]` (value).
Bug: the CDATA serialization writes `<![[CDATA[` instead of `<![CDATA[`; the result is not valid XML.
The escape function `esc` returns two values (gsub) and does not escape the apostrophe despite its entry in the table.

dom.desc: Parses the XML into a flat DOM. Returns a document node {type='document', name='#doc', kids, root}. Elements carry name, nsURI, nsPrefix, kids, attr (list + dictionary) and, outside simple mode, el and parent. Texts have type='text', value and cdata.

xml.desc: Serializes a node (document, element, text, comment, processing instruction) into an XML string.

opts.desc: indent (number of spaces or string), sort (sort the attributes), omit (list of namespace URIs or values to omit).

returns.desc: XML text (lines separated by a newline if indent is given, otherwise concatenated).
